adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, `feed_key` is defined but never referenced anywhere in the diff (no calls in `execute`/`poll_feed` or elsewhere), so it is dead code. Likewise `embed.permalink` is added in `config/locales/server.en.yml` but no view/controller code in the diff uses that key (the embed views use `embed.title`, `embed.start_discussion`, `embed.continue`, `embed.loading`, `embed.imported_from`). The broader point about missing caching is directionally supported: `poll_feed` iterates all `rss.items` each run and calls `TopicEmbed.import` for each, which recomputes `content_sha1` every time; however, it does *not* necessarily “re-import” unchanged items because `TopicEmbed.import` no-ops on unchanged `content_sha1` for existing `embed_url`s.
